svg.title: Cerulion architecture: robot graph, network planes, desk tools
svg.desc: Robot: a graph scheduler drives Sensors, Perception and Control; nodes publish into and read from iceoryx2 shared memory; recording and Flashback capture every frame; cerulion-netd serves LAN and WAN (Iroh) planes on demand. Desk: cerulion-netd mirrors demanded topics locally for Cerulion Studio and the CLI; account ownership and grants authorize the WAN plane on both machines; the CLI drives replay; replay, verification and CI consume the recording. The animation plays one scheduler cycle: the scheduler drives Sensors, then Perception, then Control, each publishing into and reading from shared memory; the frame reaches the robot daemon, the desk daemon requests it, the account authorizes the link, the data crosses to the desk, into the local mirror and up to Studio; every frame is also recorded and carried into Replay, verification and CI, which the CLI resims.
svg.text: One graph on the robot. One view from your desk.
Decode and rendering on the desk
Native data stays in shared memory locally. Network delivery follows subscriptions. Replay turns recorded behavior into a test.
